page.layout: One printed page. Top: ornamental fleuron row, then centred title and heading "INDEX" in capitals. Below: a running paragraph of introductory prose in full width. Below that: two index columns with a large initial A at left, page numbers in the right of each column. Handwritten number at upper right is not printed text.

main_text.l: Meminerit Lector Anglica nos hic vocare,
quæ verè talia sunt: id est, quæ sexcento-
rum ad minimum annorum antiquitatem præferunt,
& veteribus Anglis sive Saxonibus ante corruptio-
nem linguæ, quæ posterioribus seculis contigit, erant
in usu: Horum, (quæ quidem hic repræsentantur)
in usu sunt hodieque, leviter immutata, pleraque:
verunt. Alia quæ sunt alterius generis si quæ (de
quibusdam enim dubitabamus) hic reperiantur, ins-
cientibus id nobis & imprudentibus factum est.

page.notes: Index is set in two columns with page numbers at right of each column. The handwritten "251" at upper right is not printed. Some headwords are partly illegible in the scan and have been read with best judgement; the column of "A" entries uses the printed initial. Blue numbers are printed cross-references.
